content.title: Arman Tsarukyan v Georgio Poullas and Colby Covington v Dillon Danis LIVE: RAF7 stream info, start time and results
content.text: Arman Tsarukyan’s most bitter feud outside of the UFC will come to a head tonight in Tampa, Florida on the RAF mats.Last month, the top UFC lightweight contender came to blows with Georgio Poullas following a contentious and dirty match at RAF6 in Arizona. And within a few weeks, they have managed to organize a rematch, cancel it, and book a new one for tonight’s RAF Wrestling event. Arrow Left #1 Icon Created with Sketch. Arrow right #1 Icon Created with Sketch. Can Arman Tsarukyan be trusted with a UFC title shot? Between punching a fan at UFC 300, his Dan Hooker headbutt and now the RAF brawl, is Arman Tsarukyan too much of a loose canon for the UFC title? Photo by Jeff Bottari/Zuffa LLC hayerjan323Featured commentlol that’s funny I think Tito would beat his ass too and I don’t even know the guydr.cheynoFeatured commentNot defending Dana at all, but his wife hit him harder 😂philosopher1130Featured commentCan’t believe this is such an “issue” when Conor attacking a bus full of fighters and injuring multiple was used for promo for his fight with Khabib. Hypocrisy at its finest 🤦🏽 Theirs is not the only grudge match on the exciting freestyle wrestling card as two of MMA’s most notorious heels face off. BJJ black belt Dillon Danis makes his debut in the sport against the wrestling sensation Colby Covington in a match that got personal during last night’s press conference.If you’re more interested in top-level wrestling competition, then you’ll see two Olympic gold medalists competing on the undercard. Kyle Snider takes on Akhmed Tazhudinov in a battle of multiple-time world champions that could headline any other event in wrestling history.The Yuengling Center in Tampa, Florida is the host venue for the night, with thousands expected to pack in to watch some UFC stars headline a night of brilliant wrestling action.
